reforms.description: The Japanese government provided financial assistance in the form of grants, concessional loans, and special tax benefits to promote research and development in technologically-advanced industries.
reforms.growth_orientation_rationale: This funding enhances R&D capabilities, fostering innovation and competitiveness in key industries.
reforms.status_evidence: Government financial assistance was provided under various schemes.
reforms.importance_rationale: This reform represents a significant investment in R&D that is crucial for the advancement of Japan's technological capabilities and global competitiveness.
reforms.source_quote: The expansion of technologically-sophisticated industries was promoted by specific development plans formulated by MITI and government financial assistance provided under various schemes.
